Agent skills wave (two arXiv papers on the same day ask whether models can actually invoke and compose packaged skills inside a harness and whether they spread across distinct skills at all - the empirical question sitting under the entire repo boom; five skills repos hold trending slots simultaneously, mattpocock adds +4,503 in two days on an accelerating 7d rate, and vertical packs like scientific-agent-skills are the second wave)

Agent skills wave (skills crosses from community convention to vendor-shipped artifact — google/skills and android/skills are both on today's boards, while mattpocock/skills posts the largest 7-day move of any tracked repo at +10,365 with the rate flat-to-rising rather than decaying and addyosmani/agent-skills nearly doubles its board gain; CSIRO Data61's SkillZip compresses a growing skill library while preserving each skill's interface contract)
